specs.Metrics Measured: LBS Location Tracking, Calling & Voice Chat, SOS Alerts
specs.Communication Feature: Phone Call, Text Message, Voice Call

features: [Main Features] : 2-Way Calling | LBS Location Tracking | Text & Voice SMS | Camera | SOS Button | Safe Zone Alert | Remote Monitoring | Class Mode (Do Not Disturb Mode) | Remote Shutdown | Remote Photo | Hear Background Noise | Full Parental Control /Enable or Disable any watch function via Sekyo App
[Calling watch for Kids] : Stay connected with your child at all times through seamless two-way communication via 2G voice calling, voice chatting or SMS with this Kids smart watch for boys & girls.

[Location Tracking] – Provides nearby location details using LBS technology. Please note, this is approximate and may not always be precise. For accurate real-time GPS tracking, we recommend our 4G model.
[Class Mode] : Ensure your child's focus on learning by activating Class Mode on this Kids SmartWatch for boys & girls during school hours to prevent distractions from calls/messages.

[SOS Panic Button] : In emergencies, your child can press the SOS button on this Kids smart watch with sim card to send an immediate distress signal to pre-set contacts. The SOS button on the kids safety watch can make a significant difference when your child needs help, instantly notifying parents and emergency contacts.

[Remote Monitoring] : Parents can always fetch a photo remotely from the camera embedded in this Sekyo S2 Pro smart watch with Sim Card to remotely check your child's surrounding. It can give you piece of mind about your child safety when they can't answer the call.

[Geo-Fence In/Out Smart Watch] : Create electronic boundaries around areas like home or school with Geofencing. Receive notifications when your child enters or leaves these zones, enhancing their safety.

[Network Compatibility] : Supports Airtel & Vi Micro SIM only. Jio SIM is not supported. This smartwatch works only on a 2G network. [NOTE]: Do not use a charger/adapter with an output higher than 15W.
